constraints.text: Mother Nature beckons you ... boots on the ground ... Take a friend. Bring a picnic. Find a treasure.
constraints.reading: The hiding spot is an outdoor natural setting, not an indoor/urban place. It is pleasant enough to picnic at, implying a place where one can sit comfortably (a flat-ish, open or scenic resting spot rather than a sheer crag or dense thicket).

constraints.text: boots on the ground ... reached on foot; public land, near a road, not dangerous (no water crossings, cliff scaling)
constraints.reading: Spot is within walking distance of a road (author elsewhere confirms ~3 miles), on solid ground reachable without scaling cliffs or crossing water. The terrain immediately at the spot is non-hazardous to stand on.

constraints.text: Not buried — no digging required on public lands.
constraints.reading: The box sits on or against an existing natural feature at or above ground level (in a crevice, under a ledge/overhang, behind/beneath a rock, in a hollow), not in dug earth. Look for a ready-made natural cavity or shelf.

constraints.text: custom-made treasure box, closed — light tan/beige metal panels set in a dark gunmetal/iron frame, with dark corner brackets, two dark top straps, a front latch, and dark feet
constraints.reading: The physical object is a rectangular box with pale tan panels in a dark frame; its pale-on-dark coloring could let it blend against light rock framed by dark crevice shadow. Its size (smaller four are six-figure; this one substantially larger) implies a cavity big enough to conceal a sizeable chest.

constraints.text: the fifth box is substantially larger and holds the lion's share ... custom-forged by blacksmith Seth Gould
constraints.reading: Because the Lion's Share box is the largest of the five, the concealment feature must be a comparatively large recess/overhang/crevice — not a small pocket. Favor a roomy natural shelter over a tiny niche.

constraints.text: Where your pleasure is, there is your treasure: where your treasure, there your heart; where your heart, there your happiness.
constraints.reading: Epigraph chain (pleasure/heart/happiness) is thematic, but charitably it may hint the spot is a place of personal joy — likely scenic or emotionally resonant (an overlook or a beautiful resting place). 'Heart' could echo a central/heart-of-the-feature position.

constraints.text: The only joy in the world is to begin. —CESARE PAVESE
constraints.reading: Thematic about beginning the hunt; weak spatial content. Possible faint hint toward a starting point / trailhead-adjacent location, but unreliable.

constraints.text: an idea riding like a wild cowboy upon a lightning bolt of inspiration ... drawn to joy like the proverbial moth to the fiery flame
constraints.reading: Recurring fire/lightning/Western imagery (also 'Thoreau's Fire'). Charitably could echo a burned area, a lightning-struck or fire-scarred tree/rock, a high exposed ridge where lightning strikes, or an elevated open vista (cowboy/wide country). Speculative.

constraints.text: research was like panning for gold ... waded out into a stream of time ... driving past the Ozarks
constraints.reading: Gold-panning / 'wading into a stream' imagery faintly associates with flowing water; the spot could be near a stream or creek (consistent with 'no water crossings' — beside, not across, water). Treat as atmospheric, not literal.

constraints.text: Arkenstone = the Heart of the Mountain, the great glowing gem at the heart of a mountain hoard; resonates with a recurring mountain-treasure motif
constraints.reading: Mountain-treasure motif (gem at the heart/center of a mountain) charitably suggests an elevated, mountainous setting and possibly a central or interior feature of a peak/ridge. Generic high-ground hint, not a place.

constraints.text: Sweet Home Mine ... rhodochrosite; The Arkenstone iconically linked to a high mountain mineral locality in national forest
constraints.reading: Associated signature mineral (rhodochrosite) is rose/red and the box panels are tan; weak hint that the spot may involve reddish or pale rock. Mineral/rock-face context, not soil. Low confidence.

constraints.text: Thoreau's Fire ... fire escaped on the east shore of Fair Haven Bay ... 'the Cliffs', Fairhaven Hill, woods now public conservation land
constraints.reading: Item-history imagery (raw, location-agnostic): an EAST-facing shoreline, a hill/cliff feature overlooking water, and a fire-scarred woodland. Generically supports: an east-side ledge/cliff with a view over water below, set in woods. Use only as feature-type guidance.

constraints.text: Onassis brooch ... carved rock-crystal panels; former estate now conservation land between a trail and a pond, near dunes/heath, near a road, no digging
constraints.reading: Item-history raw features (location-agnostic): a clear/frosted rock-crystal object; a setting between a named trail and a pond, with dune/heath ground cover. Generically supports a spot near a path and a body of still water, on open heath/dune terrain.

constraints.text: Tiffany ... estate overlooking a harbor; furnace/glasshouse; salvaged windows
constraints.reading: Item-history imagery (location-agnostic): an estate overlooking water from height. Generic support for an elevated spot with a long water view. Low confidence.

constraints.text: Carnegie ... island with ruins (pedestrian-ferry-only); Johnstown Flood memorial
constraints.reading: Item-history raw features: ruins, an island, and a flood/dam site (water imagery). Generic feature hints: near old ruins/stonework or near water; not directional. Low confidence.

constraints.text: Washington jelly glass ... small (~4 in.) cut-glass dessert vessel, 'English Rose' pattern
constraints.reading: Object is small, rounded/cup-shaped clear cut glass with a rose motif. Charitably the spot's micro-feature could be cup/bowl-shaped (a rounded hollow or basin) or marked by a rose-colored/rose-shaped element. Highly speculative shape echo.

constraints.text: George Washington's jelly glass ... 'English Rose' pattern; rose motif
constraints.reading: Recurring rose imagery could faintly suggest a pinkish/rose-toned rock or a rose/laurel plant near the spot. Speculative.
